title: MCP Gateway Playground
name: mcp-apps-playground
author: atko-scratch
description: An Auth0-hosted MCP server for the MCP Gateway Playground travel and Auth0 Forms tools.

auth0.scopes: read:resource_servers create:resource_servers read:connections update:connections read:tenant_settings update:tenant_settings create:client_grants read:client_grants

SESSION_SECRET.description: At least 32 characters. Signs the short-lived context JWT used by the Auth0 Forms tools.

AUTH0_FORMS_PROFILE_FORM_ID.description: ID of the Auth0 Form used by the Update profile tool in this tenant, for example ap_abc123.

AUTH0_FORMS_PAYMENT_FORM_ID.description: ID of the Auth0 Form used by the Update payment details tool in this tenant, for example ap_abc123.

PUBLIC_BASE_URL.description: Optional external public MCP origin override, for example https://mcp.example.com. Leave empty for the installed Webtask URL.
